title: carex longipes subsp. nepalensis
intro: Carex longipes subsp. nepalensis, commonly known as Nepalese sedge, is a subspecies of the Carex longipes plant, belonging to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Carex longipes subsp. nepalensis include soothing and calming effects, making it a possible remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
